$comment: BM-8 author-catch guards — the Settings Evolution round's Phase-10 minting (M6): the round's three benchmark-authoring failures minted as pinned tasks, plus the phantom-drift find the minting work itself produced. Each task pins a catch class so it cannot silently recur. (1) phantomDrift: on a pristine home /settings diff must say 'No settings differ' — the registry's declared defaults had drifted from the vendored pi defaults, so every fresh install showed 8 phantom drift rows; the unit pin is test/settings-defaults-drift.test.ts, this is the pane-truth pin. (2) toggleMarker: the editor's selected row carries the '→' marker ('→ Turn ON'); the first benchmark run matched by prefix and never hit — this task asserts the marker renders BEFORE matching, so a product change that drops the marker turns the task red consciously. (3) noopDrift: the BM-5 first-run catch — a probe that sets a setting to its CURRENT value shows no drift; this task reads the current value and sets current+offset (never equal by construction), then the diff must name the drifted key. The runner also validates every task's diskCheck.expect against the registry's declared defaults (the diff-inert warning). (4) registry-parse: procedural (audit-registry.mjs import + bisect-registry.mjs --selftest) — the missing-paren catch's net.

phantomDrift.expectText: No settings differ from their defaults.
